end.summary:
Practised ways to keep school clean, green and safe, including using bins and cleaning the blackboard; this is still building and needs checking next time.
Practised sorting wet waste and dry waste and discussing a compost pit; this is still building and needs checking next time.
Anika repeatedly said peels and plastic wrappers or spoons all turn into soil in a compost pit.
The plastic-and-compost mix-up was still present in the final response, so it was not corrected after the last time it appeared.
end.parentNote: Asha practised everyday school-care actions and sorting wet waste from dry waste using examples such as peels, wrappers and plastic spoons. Anika suggested putting wrappers and plastic in the compost pit; this mix-up remained at the end, so the next lesson should revisit that plastic does not compost and belongs in the blue bin. At home, sort a few kitchen items together and ask which can rot in a compost pit and which should go in the dry-waste bin.
